task.title: Read option declarations from project.conf includes
task.problem: Options declared in files that project.conf pulls in with (@) were invisible to --all-options, --list-options and --options-template, so they were neither enumerated nor templated.
task.proposal: Compose project-local (@) includes with BuildStream's own Includes before reading declarations, matching its first loading pass; report junction includes, whose options need the subproject loaded.
acceptance: Options declared in local includes (top level, inside options:, nested) are listed, templated and enumerated, with the including file overriding the included one as in BuildStream.
Junction includes are not loaded before the search; a note names each, and options they declare are reported after loading as held.
Recursive includes fail with BuildStream's error.
evidence: test_declared_options_follow_local_includes, test_declared_options_report_recursive_include and the include fixture in test_all_options_searches_union_of_option_sets pass against BuildStream 2.8.1.
